title: Target-Conditioned BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier
summary: The solution lowercases comments and tokenizes words, apostrophized terms, and punctuation. It truncates to 192 tokens and builds a training-only vocabulary from tokens occurring at least three times; padding and unknown IDs are reserved. A two-layer bidirectional LSTM processes learned 256-dimensional embeddings with spatial embedding dropout. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU dense layers, and mapped to one toxicity logit. Training uses fractional-target binary cross-entropy plus a penalty that equalizes mean predicted probabilities between identity-present and identity-absent examples within each hard toxicity class. Each epoch shuffles rows, length-sorts within buckets, then shuffles batches. AdamW uses linear warmup followed by cosine decay, fp16 autocasting, gradient scaling, and global norm clipping. Validation batches are length-sorted; sigmoid probabilities are restored to prepared validation-row order and evaluated.
